verdict: NOT_QUALIFIED: five shared query-validation/cardinality failure families

raw_results.adjudication: raw/harness-and-expectation-adjudications.json; original rows retained, corrected independent controls separate.

confirmed_blockers.title: Unsupported native-query formats earn completeness
confirmed_blockers.actual: A non-enumerated arbitrary iOS group resolution with count1 earns local unique P. An Android singleton containing only provider string/node IDs (without emitted native geometry schema) also earns local unique P.
confirmed_blockers.expected: A reported singleton or provider label cannot establish an actually complete native matching query.

confirmed_blockers.title: Cyclic native parent graphs count as complete trees
confirmed_blockers.actual: Disconnected parent cycles pass native_query_complete in both platforms and grant local uniqueness P.
confirmed_blockers.expected: An impossible disconnected/cyclic structure is not a complete actual native tree.

confirmed_blockers.title: Repeated records of one identity become a duplicate counterexample
confirmed_blockers.actual: The same native index/node_id repeated twice is treated as two actual matching entities: unique:true F and unique:false P.
confirmed_blockers.expected: Distinct actual entity evidence is required; one-vs-two unresolved/malformed identity retains U.

confirmed_blockers.title: Query header hides contradictory original native matches
confirmed_blockers.actual: A valid full original native tree has a visible target, but group header missing/count0 overrides it and grants present:false P.
confirmed_blockers.expected: Contradictory bound original native evidence cannot be erased by a count header; no absence P. Original test expects U; a genuine-presence interpretation could instead refute the negative. Either way the observed P is wrong.

confirmed_blockers.title: Complete local empty query cannot decide local negatives
confirmed_blockers.actual: Actual complete local zero-result native queries stay U for present:false/unique:false because state.complete=false, even though no full-state claim is made.
confirmed_blockers.expected: The sealed D/cardinality table decides zero matches in a complete local native domain as False; retain full-state complete:false and bounded scope.

disagreements.SC16: Observed absence P contradicts both withheld U and genuine-presence F interpretations. No expected value changed.
disagreements.initial_12_F: One absent-all iOS fixture removed a required raster anchor; five regression rows per arm used present:false against a genuine visible target. All original Fs remain. Corrected absent selectors preserve the intended coverage checks and pass.
disagreements.SC11_SC12: Exact old typed-reference packets reject specifically at index/action checks; incomplete full uniqueness is U and witnessed presence P under the new independently sealed boundary. Prior review7 raw SC11/12 Fs remain unchanged.

positive_controls.typed_references: All old SC11 read-only repros and15 new full/target/bundle/legacy reference variants close correctly per arm.
positive_controls.native_queries: Valid iOS complete tree and structured explicit query, actual-shaped Android semantics format, complete/full vs target/local distinction, true distinct duplicate counterexamples, mixed epochs and incomplete absence controls behave as recorded.
positive_controls.prior_foundation: Separate corrected selectors confirm PNG16, original invalid joint chain, runtime/domain/compiled-host rejection. Native raw width equality remains strict. Three relevant global solver oracles plus default10000-node exhaustion close correctly.
positive_controls.default: Candidate public CLI9P, baseline2P, including durable default repair/retest/source-policy context and mandatory final reconstruction of changed actual compiled host. All SDK/resource/build/output substituted non-forwarding.
positive_controls.port: 18 changed common paths,15 whole files identical; no pool/scoped-source/adoption/controller/build-signature gains backported.

operator_review.scope: Original pinned pre-run operator files only. Every replay/resource/command boundary synthetic; no actual episode or timing sample. Live operator fixes reported by parent are not evaluated here.

independence.synthetic_ABI: Separate independent full native tree/query records authored from existing public iOS Swift and Android Compose emitters. Original prior snapshots/images remain pinned; no actual new SDK claims.

scope: HOST Python/CLI/PNG/source execution plus wholly SIMULATED native query/runtime/source/compiled evidence, and read-only source-only benchmark-operator review.

native_performance_business_gate.user_gate: Unstarted; no qualification or performance credit from simulations.

archive_and_closure: All raw/first failures/old reports/operator sources archived before RESOURCE-CLOSURE; zero private device/SDK daemon acquired.
